title: Datumesh describe answer: a function
description: SPEC.md 16.8, spec-0.6.0; since spec-0.6.1 the optional publisher (the host of fn: checked by the procedure, E_DESCRIBE). Unsigned, the mesh's statement. fn_hash is 64 lowercase hex digits; when the client holds the descriptor of fn_hash, args and returns are its signature's, all of its arguments (checked by the procedure, E_DESCRIBE). description is 1 to 1024 bytes (counted in bytes by the procedure).

publisher.description: spec-0.6.1 (16.8, D108): the host of the name's namespace, a DNS name; never the domain of a later segment. Optional and additive.

args.description: The function's arguments with their types and units, all of them.
